text: Implemented typed condition spaces, semantic effect maps, coefficient-parameterization receipts, semantic lowering and an explicit raw target path. Cell-means/treatment codings share effect identity and produce equal floating-point extractors at 1e-12 while parameterization/lowering receipts differ; raw routes hash X/T vocabulary and lack symbolic/coding-invariant capabilities. Full suite passes with only four opt-in scale skips. relation_plan_id composition will consume this semantic id in Phase 3.
